The Voidstorm is a collection of Void energies that ravage Cosmic Horizon of Telogrus Rift. The storm is growing in strength, and while some void elves have already been consumed by it, the isle itself is also at risk.

Voidfire is a black whelp located outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration. When he showed up at the pet playground, he started causing chaos, and Alyx sent adventurers to talk to him. He hoped to become as powerful as Deathwing, so the hero showed him the destruction caused by the former black Aspect in the Burning Steppes, Badlands, and Shimmering Expanse. Upon seeing the areas, he realized that destruction isn't fun, so he resolved to be more like Nozdormu since he uses time travel.

Its appearance occasionally shifts between light and void. The two different appearances match the Lightwing Dragonhawk and the Voidwing Dragonhawk. Champions can ascend a towering structure filled with formidable foes and cosmic horrors, leading to a showdown with Imperator Averzian and Salhadaar in this six-boss raid. Xal'atath created the Voidspire using the power inside the Dark Heart, and the techniques taught to her by the domanaar.

Their low health pretty much guarantees that any damage coming their way, will end the pack however. As such they are very weak against AoE. A squad of vultures start at two members.

The Warcraft 30th Anniversary World Tour was a series of events organized by Blizzard Entertainment to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the Warcraft universe. The tour features six gatherings in different cities around the world, starting in London on 22 February 2025 and concluding in Boston on May 10 during PAX East. At each event, attendees can enjoy live entertainment, meet Warcraft developers, and participate in unique activities. The tour celebrates all Warcraft games, including World of Warcraft, Hearthstone, and Warcraft Rumble.
Warcloak of the Butcher drops from Ash'an the Empowered in Maisara Deeps in Zul'Aman.

Warlocks were given expanded customization options in the barbershop starting in Patch 10.1.5 for the Summon Imp, Summon Voidwalker, Summon Felhunter, Summon Sayaad, Summon Felguard, Summon Infernal, Summon Darkglare, and Summon Demonic Tyrant abilities, unlocked through consumable items called grimoires primarily, or given to the warlock by default.

The Warlands are an alternate universe of Azeroth, visited during the Time Rifts. The Warlands are in a time of a never-ending battle between Horde and Alliance, now named Blood Horde and Great Glorious Alliance. The Varian Wrynn encounter takes place on gunships of these factions. After the encounter, an Oil-Soaked Log Book shows up inside the cabin of the Alliance gunship, presenting the Great Glorious Alliance's side of the endless conflict.
Wardens Champion's Insignia is a reward from The Wardens world quests throughout the Broken Isles. It can also be looted from treasures through the isles or a Cache of Infinite Power.

Warlord Sargha is a boss in Neltharus. She has been a warlord of the Qalashi tribe for at least 20,000 years, and was considered a notable threat by the dragons of the Waking Shores. When the Dragon Isles reawakened in 40 ADP, she lead a force of djaradin into the undefended Obsidian Citadel by breaking into the vaults below. While her forces spread across the citadel, she remained in Neltharus to investigate the secrets of Neltharion and seek out sources of power, before being defeated by adventurers.
Warrior's Bounty appears after using the correct warrior abilities on the Combat Dummies near the Rustmaul Digsite in the Shimmering Flats. It contains Rune of Intervention.

Weed Reaper Basir is an Arathi located in Hallowfall. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Basir answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. He was stationed at a camp to the south of the Untamed Valley in Azj-Kahet.

The Web Terror is a spider found during the fight against Zekvir. Zekvir will call for a Web Terror which will spawn a Egg Cocoon in the area, hatching into the Web Terror in just 20 seconds. After hatching, the Web Terror continuously casts the Web Blast ability, causing a lot of damage to all the players in the area. The Egg Cocoon should be burst down before they can hatch into the Web Terror.

Weathered of the Undermine is a feat of strength earned by outgrowing the use of the Weathered Undermine Crest during The War Within Season 2. This requires reaching an item level of 632 or higher in all equipment slots. Once done, players can trade their Weathered crests up to Carved Undermine Crests in a 3-to-1 ratio by speaking with Vaskarn. The macro below will display slots that are below the required item level: /run local n=tInvert(Enum.ItemRedundancySlot),a;for i=0,16 do a = C_ItemUpgrade.GetHighWatermarkForSlot(i); if a Upon earning the achievement, Vaskarn sends players the following in-game mail attached with a Crimson Valorstone, containing 100 Valorstones.

Wenren Althal was an Arathi quest giver located at Beledar's Bounty in Hallowfall. The last surviving mage of the Hallowfall Arathi, he was working on a way to open a portal back to the Arathi Empire, and eventually asked adventurers to assist him in his experiments. With their help, he discovered a way to return his people to their homeland, and wondered if his pet cat Larky was still at home. However, Tefferty Ulreth, a grizzled member of the Hallowfall Expedition who assisted Wenren to reunite with his wife who stayed behind in the empire, turned out to be a member of the Order of Night. He ultimately assassinated Wenren and destroyed his research before the mage could put it into practic

Whelp Eggs are a unit of the family in Warcraft Rumble. As eggs, they are a non-attacking ground unit; upon hatching into whelps, they become flying units. They can be set in front of traveling melee enemies to deal damage, or they can be placed near a point of interest ahead of time to "guard" it. A squad of whelp eggs is made up of three members.

The White Mechanostrider Mod A was an epic mechanostrider mount sold by Milli Featherwhistle in Dun Morogh before patch 1.4.0. It was removed from Milli's inventory with the addition of new, more impressive-looking epic mounts. Players who'd already bought a White Mechanostrider could exchange it for one of the new mounts via the White Mechanostrider Replacement quest. This mount was later renamed to White Mechanostrider Mod B. Having this mount awards the Old School Ride Feat of Strength.

The Wild Feeding Pits is an area found in the Waking Shores, within the Wild Preserve. With War Mode enabled, the area is a Free For All and How to Train a Proto-Drake is sometimes available. Proto-dragons and their nests are found in high numbers, and the ground is covered in animal bones. The red dragonflight is known to capture and relocate proto-drakes to other areas when the population grows too dense.

The Wild Hatchery is an area found in the Waking Shores, in the northeast section of the Wild Preserve. It is an outpost where the Red Dragonflight “keep watch over the proto-drakes in the area”. Within, Firellon tends to an infused egg, while a Ruby Sitter watches over a clutch of eggs in a cart. Ruby Cullers defend the entrances. After her battle with Raszageth, Alexstrasza fell into the waters near the hatchery. Once she recovered, she had a conversation with Wrathion and soon left the area.

The WoW Lofi Beats To Chill To - Waiting for BlizzCon is an album of several remixes of a few original songs from World of Warcraft. It was first released as a video on YouTube on 12 October 2023 and has a length of 3 hours. It released on Spotify, Apple Music, and Deezer on 28 November 2023. The image features Jaina Proudmoore reading from a small room in Stormwind Keep overlooking the city.

WoW's 20th Anniversary is a feat of strength earned by logging in during the 20th anniversary of World of Warcraft. It could only be earned starting on November 4, as a bug made it unavailable prior to that date.

WoWmapview is an open source 3D map viewer for World of Warcraft. It uses the data files included with the game to display the 3D game world, which allows the user to explore by flying anywhere. It allows access to off-limits developer areas and unfinished instance maps. The program has not receive any development updates since the latest version in 2005.

NO MORE!" is one of the exclamations made by Disobedient Dragonmaw Peons that need to be disciplined with a Booterang during The Booterang: A Cure For The Common Worthless Peon, a daily quest for the Netherwing faction in Shadowmoon Valley. The line became a meme in the World of Warcraft community and has been referenced by other peons in later expansions. In , peons in Dazar'alor and Warfang Hold use the variant "", and go on to say that they're so dissatisfied with their work that they plan to switch careers and train to "be somebody". World of Warcraft Classic: Season of Discovery (abbreviated as SOD) is the second seasonal release for World of Warcraft: Classic, introducing a reimagined progression system where players uncover hidden runes to unlock new abilities, including unconventional class roles like warlock and shaman-tanks. The season features phased level caps, redesigned instances and completely new instances, and experimental PvP events, offering a fresh take on the vanilla experience. Each phase of Season of Discovery introduces a curated set of content tuned to its level cap, including redesigned dungeons, new raids or dungeons, and class-specific rune discoveries. The Wu Kao Assassins are a squad of Shado-Pan operatives coordinated by Ling of the Six Pools, part of the larger Wu Kao discipline within the order. They are based out of the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes, fighting mantid on the island of Sra'vess. Shado-Pan daily quests rotate through sets of quests for the Assassins, the Blackguard Defenders, and the Omnia Mystics on different days. When the Assassins are active, heroes may ask one of them (other than Ling) to accompany them on the day's missions. They use agility-based fighting styles and all provide stealth to both themselves and the player character while on Sra'vess, essentially providing a permanent Shroud of Concealment.

Xy Imports Receiving is an area located within Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. It is a set of docks that leads directly to Xy Imports Offices. Just outside of the office is Xy'nell, who is attempting to recruit adventurers to sabotage his own cartel's operations, Cartel Xy. It is explained that this is not being done out of malice for the cartel, but because their overseer, Coordinator Xy'thir, has been running the area like a tyrant and murdered someone. With aid from adventurers, Xy'thir is captured by the Cartel Zo security team; and Xy'nell is appointed to replace him.

Ysabel Gleamgaard is an Arathi located in Wildcamp Or'lay in Azj-Kahet. She was worried about her injured sister and was hesitant about the camp's haranir and did not want to offend them. Despite this, the haranir provided help to the sisters, and Ysabel planned to repay it. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Ysabel answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. She was stationed at Faerin's Advance in Azj-Kahet.

You Conduit! is a feat of strength earned by rescuing Kasreth's experimental pet, Gortham, from the pipes of Nexus-Point Xenas. Acquiring the pet is one of the secrets that counts for Mind-Seeker. Then, all five players need to stand on the five Corespark Conduits simultaneously to dislodge something, popping out the capybara in a Netherstorm Structural Cage! Once the pet has been unlocked, other level players can zone in to the dungeon and loot the pet as well.

Zskarn is a boss in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible. He managed Neltharion's experiments for over 20,000 years and was responsible for testing and evaluating the newly created dracthyr. He also assisted Neltharion in the creation of Kazzara, the Hellforged, as well as numerous other experiments. When the Sundered Flame claimed Aberrus, he allied himself with them against the black dragonflight and their allies. He was slain by their forces soon after.

With Liadrin's aid, Zul'jarra underwent the trials to become a Hash'ey and reunited the Amani with their loa. 2K Marin is an American and Australian video game developer based in Novato, California and Canberra, Australia. The studio's main focus according to press releases is to develop new intellectual property and co-develop products with other 2K studios. The Novato studio was spun off from Irrational Games (briefly known as 2K Boston/2K Australia) in 2007, after the release of BioShock. The Canberra studio, 2K Australia, was originally part of Irrational Games. It joined 2K Marin in 2010, upon the announcement of its new XCOM game.
